name: What kind of warranty should I expect for a new roof?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty should I expect for a new roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new roof typically comes with two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty on the materials and a contractor's warranty on the workmanship. Manufacturer warranties often range from 25 years to lifetime, while workmanship warranties can vary from 5 to 20 years. Ensure you understand the terms and duration of both before proceeding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a manufacturer's warranty on materials and a contractor's warranty on workmanship. Understand the terms and duration of both.
